user.title: Connect ClickUp
user.description:
To connect your workspace, you need an API key and a Team ID.

- **API Key**: Go to ClickUp → Settings → Apps → Personal Token.
- **Team ID**: Look at the URL in your browser when using ClickUp (e.g. `app.clickup.com/1234567/...` where `1234567` is the Team ID).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to ClickUp. Please try again later.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid API Key. Please check your Personal Token.
error.workspace_not_authorized: This API Key does not have access to this workspace.

data_description.clickup_language: The language in which your tasks are written. The AI uses this to accurately understand search queries and filter your tasks.
data_description.translate_task_names: If enabled, the AI will dynamically translate task names into your current Assist language.
data_description.include_subtasks: Allow the AI to search and interact with subtasks. If disabled, only parent tasks and projects will be available.
